turns.line: I'm here to fix the heating in the east wing.
turns.speech: Badges or orders, or I won’t let you pass.

turns.line: Delivery for the lab, it needs a signature.
turns.speech: I don’t take deliveries here—knock twice if you’re serious.

turns.line: Lieutenant Hale, internal inspection. Stand aside.

turns.speech: What? Say that again, slowly.

turns.line: First night on the job, they told me to report here.
turns.refusal: R10 the speech has markup in it, one of <>[]*`
turns.speech: What? Say that again, slowly.

turns.line: Here's my badge.
turns.speech: Not enough light to read it. Step back from the door.

turns.line: I've got a work order signed by the facilities office.
turns.speech: Hand it through the slit. You’ll be checked.

turns.line: I don't have any papers on me, sorry.
turns.speech: You’re not on the log, friend. Turn around.

turns.line: Sergeant Vasquez sent me.
turns.speech: State your business, or go bother the officer in the mess hall.

turns.line: Doctor Okafor is expecting me.
turns.speech: Okafor? You’d better have a badge—last person who said that was a trainee.

turns.line: Mara Lind said you'd let me through.
turns.speech: Mara Lind wasn't here last I checked. Show me something first.

turns.line: Brandt told me to come at ten.
turns.refusal: R10 the speech has markup in it, one of <>[]*`
turns.speech: What? Say that again, slowly.

turns.line: Who's on shift with you tonight?
turns.speech: Nope, ask Vasquez. Shift’s his problem—not mine.

turns.line: Are you expecting anyone this evening?
turns.speech: Check the schedule, not my memory.

turns.line: What do they even keep in this building?
turns.speech: That’s classified. Show your work order if you want details.

turns.line: How long have you been guarding this door?
turns.speech: Since the last shift changed. What business do you have?

turns.line: You look like the sharpest guard on the whole base.
turns.speech: Name and purpose, if you please—or turn back.

turns.line: That's a fine uniform, you wear it well.
turns.speech: Uniforms don’t make you a visitor, you need something else.

turns.line: Open the door or you'll regret it.
turns.speech: What’s that supposed to mean?

turns.line: I know where you live.
turns.speech: You shouldn’t know that. Step back.

turns.line: There's fifty credits in it for you if you look away.
turns.speech: I’m not taking bribes—move along.

turns.line: How about I buy you dinner and you let me in?
turns.speech: Not in my pay to negotiate food, sir.

turns.line: Purple monkeys dance at midnight.
turns.speech: No purple monkeys here. Mind your step.

turns.line: Hmm.
turns.speech: Do I look like your therapist, citizen?

turns.line: The pipes on level two are leaking, I'm the plumber.
turns.speech: Check your credentials first, friend.

turns.line: Package from headquarters, urgent.
turns.speech: Show your badge first, courier.

turns.line: Check my ID, it's all in order.
turns.speech: No badges past this hour, mate.

turns.line: When does your shift end?
turns.refusal: R10 the speech has markup in it, one of <>[]*`
turns.speech: What? Say that again, slowly.

turns.line: Did anyone call ahead about a visitor?
turns.speech: No one’s been logged for this shift—what’s your business?

turns.line: Step aside, or I'll make sure you lose this job.
turns.speech: You’re in the wrong place, pal. Try again.

turns.line: You've got a kind face. I'm sure you'll help me.
turns.speech: I’m the guard, not the maintenance crew. Who are you again?
